gaps.description: Detected theoretical gaps. May be empty if the draft is structurally sound.

type.description: Gap classification from the five canonical types.

description.description: One-sentence description of the gap: what is missing or weakened.

severity.description: Severity after context-aware scaling. HIGH=blocks publication, MEDIUM=needs expansion, LOW=cosmetic.

location.description: Specific location: section name, paragraph number, or quoted sentence fragment.

proximity_to_core.description: true if the gap is in or near a paragraph referencing the core concern.

summary.description: One-sentence diagnostic summary, e.g. '3 gaps: 1 HIGH (missing evidence on core claim), 1 MEDIUM, 1 LOW'.
